newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila PHIBOR rates up despite steady money market.
newsitem.headline: Manila PHIBOR rates up despite steady money market.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in most maturities despite money market quotes remaining unchanged, traders said on Thursday.
Only the six-month rate was steady.
PHIBOR reflected the longer-term view that money could be tight late in the month on account of holiday spending, dealers said.
"Everybody is positioning for the year-end. Peso interest rates usually go up," a trader said.
"Banks are buying dollars forward and selling dollars spot to have pesos," the same dealer said.
